critique: The result now has a coherent, centered Wild World-style particle field: fine magenta contour ribbons, a bright tangled interior, broad organic arches, and clear evolution from frame 1 to frame 4. Framing is substantially improved over the earlier oversized result. However, the world still occupies too much of the frame vertically, with multiple lower ribbons clipped at the bottom edge and the full silhouette reading slightly more like a constrained close-up than a comfortably contained preset composition.

suggestions.why: Slightly reduce the base X extent so the outer ribbon silhouette has more left/right breathing room without changing its centered placement.
Reduce the base Y extent to pull the lower hanging ribbons inside the frame and create a more balanced, complete world silhouette.
Scale the depth extent with the horizontal and vertical footprint so the turbulent field remains proportionate rather than retaining an oversized projected depth.
